keyPoints.en: A combined event involves two or more events, e.g. tossing a coin and rolling a dice.
keyPoints.bm: Peristiwa bergabung melibatkan dua atau lebih peristiwa, cth. melambung syiling dan dadu.

keyPoints.en: List the sample space using ordered pairs, a table (grid) or a tree diagram.
keyPoints.bm: Senaraikan ruang sampel menggunakan pasangan tertib, jadual (grid) atau gambar rajah pokok.

keyPoints.en: Number of outcomes = product of outcomes for each event (coin + dice: 2 × 6 = 12).
keyPoints.bm: Bilangan kesudahan = hasil darab kesudahan setiap peristiwa (syiling + dadu: 2 × 6 = 12).

keyPoints.en: P(A) = n(A) / n(S) when outcomes are equally likely.
keyPoints.bm: P(A) = n(A) / n(S) apabila kesudahan sama mungkin.

question.en: Two dice are rolled. Find P(both show the same number).
question.bm: Dua dadu dilambung. Cari P(kedua-duanya menunjukkan nombor sama).

tip.en: A 6 × 6 grid is the fastest way to handle two-dice questions.
tip.bm: Grid 6 × 6 cara terpantas untuk soalan dua dadu.

keyPoints.en: Independent: the outcome of A doesn't affect B. P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B).
keyPoints.bm: Tak bersandar: kesudahan A tidak mempengaruhi B. P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B).

keyPoints.en: Dependent: A changes the probability of B, e.g. picking without replacement.
keyPoints.bm: Bersandar: A mengubah kebarangkalian B, cth. mengambil tanpa pengembalian.

keyPoints.en: For dependent events: P(A and B) = P(A) × P(B given A has happened).
keyPoints.bm: Bagi peristiwa bersandar: P(A dan B) = P(A) × P(B selepas A berlaku).

keyPoints.en: Multiplication rule extends to three or more events: P(A ∩ B ∩ C) = P(A) × P(B) × P(C) if independent.
keyPoints.bm: Petua darab boleh dilanjutkan kepada tiga atau lebih peristiwa: P(A ∩ B ∩ C) = P(A) × P(B) × P(C) jika tak bersandar.

question.en: 5 cards: 2 are prizes. Two are drawn without replacement. Find P(both prizes).
question.bm: 5 kad: 2 berhadiah. Dua dicabut tanpa pengembalian. Cari P(kedua-duanya berhadiah).

tip.en: 'Without replacement' → reduce both the top and bottom numbers for the second pick.
tip.bm: 'Tanpa pengembalian' → kurangkan nombor atas dan bawah untuk ambilan kedua.

keyPoints.en: Mutually exclusive events cannot happen together: A ∩ B = ∅, so P(A ∩ B) = 0.
keyPoints.bm: Peristiwa saling eksklusif tidak boleh berlaku bersama: A ∩ B = ∅, jadi P(A ∩ B) = 0.

keyPoints.en: Mutually exclusive: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B).
keyPoints.bm: Saling eksklusif: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B).

keyPoints.en: Not mutually exclusive: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B) (don't double-count the overlap).
keyPoints.bm: Tidak saling eksklusif: P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B) (jangan kira bahagian bertindih dua kali).

keyPoints.en: A Venn diagram helps show overlap.
keyPoints.bm: Gambar rajah Venn membantu menunjukkan pertindihan.

question.en: From 1–10, find P(even or a multiple of 3).

tip.en: Don't confuse mutually exclusive (can't happen together) with independent (don't affect each other).
tip.bm: Jangan keliru antara saling eksklusif (tidak boleh berlaku bersama) dengan tak bersandar (tidak saling mempengaruhi).

keyPoints.en: Use a tree diagram for multi-step problems: multiply along branches, add between paths.
keyPoints.bm: Gunakan gambar rajah pokok untuk masalah berbilang langkah: darab sepanjang cabang, tambah antara laluan.

keyPoints.en: Probabilities on branches from the same point add up to 1.
keyPoints.bm: Kebarangkalian pada cabang dari titik yang sama berjumlah 1.

keyPoints.en: Use probability to make decisions, e.g. comparing risks or games.
keyPoints.bm: Gunakan kebarangkalian untuk membuat keputusan, cth. membandingkan risiko atau permainan.

question.en: P(rain) = 0.3. If rain, P(late) = 0.6; if not, P(late) = 0.2. Find P(late).
question.bm: P(hujan) = 0.3. Jika hujan, P(lewat) = 0.6; jika tidak, P(lewat) = 0.2. Cari P(lewat).

tip.en: Check your tree: all final probabilities must add up to 1.
tip.bm: Semak pokok anda: semua kebarangkalian akhir mesti berjumlah 1.
